title: CC1
summary: The first issue of AABB's publishing project CC, bringing together OS Seminar 1–6.
credits:
Authors: Goeun Park & Goeun Park, Dahye Jeong, Seogwon Hwang, y!, Hezin O, Min Hee Lee
Published by [AABB](https://www.instagram.com/aabb.kr/)
Design: Junyeol Baek
description: CC is a publishing project by AABB that documents the activities of contemporary visual artists onto the medium of a book. The first issue, CC1, collects OS Seminar 1–6, with Goeun Park & Goeun Park, Dahye Jeong, Seogwon Hwang, y!, Hezin O and Min Hee Lee.
